text:
Jo: Quick thread to finalize the benchmark hero for next week's launch. Need one clean chart (p95 latency vs $/1k tokens), a tiny inset table for seq=64/256/1024, and a micro-calc link.
Ravi: Will export p50/p95 and $/1k for hosted/dedicated/private. Hero seq=256. Will include quantized series as dashed lines and attach CSV/JSON for the calc.
Tori: Audience split: devs (fast + cheap) and platform (predictable p95). Two headline variants and CTA routing needed.
Hank: Visual approach: scatter x=p95(ms), y=$/1k, point size=throughput, color by deployment. Mockups: 1200x628 + 800x800 + slide 1200x1600. No tiny text on social images.
Ellen: Add product callout: smart routing keeps p95 stable during spikes. Ops teams want the before/after example.
Ravi: Note: quantization lowers cost but can affect tail. I'll annotate any "up to" claims and include raw numbers link on the landing.
Jo: Copy candidates: A) "Predictable p95. Predictable spend." B) "Serve fast, control cost." Which is best for social vs webinar?
Tori: B -> social; A -> webinar/landing. CTAs: "See benchmark & calc" and "Book capacity consult". Use UTMs to route.
Hank: I'll do color variants: blue=hosted, amber=dedicated, slate=private. Also export a grayscale slide-safe PNG.
Ravi: Deliverables: CSV+JSON and small p50/p95 table by tomorrow AM. Will include embeddings cost if marketing wants it.
Jo: Action items: @Ravi data exports, @Hank mockups, @Tori landing + UTMs + email flows, @Ellen webinar outline + FAQ. Review Thurs morning.
reminder-bot: Calendar event created: "Bench Launch Review" Wed 09:30.
Jo: Thanks team 680 Flag any risky claims here. Will stitch assets once drafts arrive.
